library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)






# 14.1. Figure 2


results_dir <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Gene/results"
prot_results_dir <- "C:/Users/User/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Prot/results"


# Import Figure 2A
p2A <- readRDS(
  file.path(
    results_dir,
    "volcano_transcriptome.rds"
  )
)

# Import Figure 2B
p2B <- readRDS(
  file.path(
    prot_results_dir,
    "volcano_proteome.rds"
  )
)

# Import Figure 2C
p2C <- readRDS(
  file.path(
    results_dir,
    "GSEA_Hallmark_RNA_vs_Protein.rds"
  )
)


figure_2 <- (
  p2A / p2B
) | p2C

figure_2
